newsitem.title: USA: 3-D Geophysical files for 4 million shares.
newsitem.headline: 3-D Geophysical files for 4 million shares.

text.p: 3-D Geophyiscal Inc said Tuesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to issue up to four million common shares.

The Englewood, Colo-based company said underwriters have been granted an over-allotment of 600,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Smith Barney Inc, Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc and Simmons & Co International.
After the offering, the company will have 11,600,000 common shares outstanding, the filing said.

Of the total net proceeds, about $20 million will be used to buy addtional systems, additional channel capacity for the six 24-bit seismic data acquisition systems it presently owns and related vehicles and equipment.
The company will also use about $6 million to repay debt and the balance, if any, for working capital and other general corporate purposes, the filing said.
